purpose: Repair the installed licensed FACETS comparator without changing the registered 4.5.0 version after a bundled-example null dereference was localized to XojoGUIFramework64.dll.

execution.mode: visible interactive installer with Windows elevation

post_repair_gate: Verify C:/Facets/Facets.exe exists and reports product version 4.5.0.
Record post-repair executable and Xojo framework hashes and signatures.
Run exactly one unchanged bundled Kct.txt control in an isolated work and TEMP/TMP directory.
If and only if the bundled control passes, run one historically successful project control.
Do not execute supplemental calibrations or read registered endpoints until both controls pass.
claim_boundary: Same-version native runtime repair only; the installer and controls do not create scientific evidence.
